meta.name: company-intel
meta.description: Research a company, industry, or competitor set using web search and seven analytical lenses. Use when you need structured intel that feeds downstream PM skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用七个分析维度研究公司、行业或竞品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做产品决策前需要结构化商业情报
copy.tagline_en: Research companies, industries, or competitors with seven analytical lenses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured business intelligence before product decisions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过七个分析维度（财务、市场、产品、竞争、趋势、PM 影响、战略信号）研究公司、行业或竞争对手，输出结构化报告，可被其他技能用于生成竞争简报、SWOT 等。
howto.when: 当你要求研究某家公司、行业或竞争对手集时触发。例如说“研究 Parker Hannifin”或“比较 Emerson、Honeywell 和 Parker Hannifin”。

say.text: 研究特斯拉及其主要竞争对手。
say.note: Claude 会先分析特斯拉，再列出竞争对手供你确认。

say.text: 给我一份关于临床数据管理行业的报告。
say.note: Claude 会按行业模式输出结构化分析。

say.text: 更新我对诺和诺德的最新情报。
say.note: Claude 会重新搜索并对比上次结果的变化。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude researches a company, industry, or competitor set using seven analytical lenses (financial, market, product, competitive, trends, PM implications, strategic signals) and produces a structured report that other skills can consume for battlecards, SWOT, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to research a specific company, industry, or named competitor set. For example, 'Research Parker Hannifin' or 'Compare Emerson, Honeywell, and Parker Hannifin'.

say_en.text: Research Tesla and its main competitors.
say_en.note: Claude will first analyze Tesla, then list competitors for confirmation.

say_en.text: Give me a report on the clinical data management industry.
say_en.note: Claude will output a sector-level structured analysis.

say_en.text: Refresh my intel on Novo Nordisk.
say_en.note: Claude will re-search and highlight changes since last time.
